sloka: तमापतन्तं सहसा समीक्ष्य दीप्तेषुचापं युधि राक्षसेन्द्रम् ।महत् समुत्पाट्य महीधराग्रं दुद्राव रक्षोधिपतिं हरीशः ।। ६.५९.३६ ।।।।
transliteration: tamāpatantaṁ sahasā samīkṣya dīpteṣucāpaṁ yudhi rākṣasendram ।mahat samutpāṭya mahīdharāgraṁ dudrāva rakṣodhipatiṁ harīśaḥ ।। 6.59.36 ।।।।

translations.english: Watching Ravana advancing suddenly on the battlefield with great speed, Sugriva took a huge mountain top and went towards Rakshasa king.
